name: Tyre Shape Bluetooth Speaker
subtitle: Compact tyre-shaped wireless Bluetooth speaker
description: Tyre Shape Bluetooth Speaker is a compact portable speaker with Bluetooth 4.2 wireless connectivity, 5W RMS output, USB charging, and Micro SD card support. Its black tyre-inspired design provides a distinctive look while keeping music playback portable for everyday indoor or outdoor use.
story: Designed around a tyre-inspired form, this speaker combines its distinctive shape with straightforward portable playback options. Bluetooth 4.2 allows wireless audio streaming from compatible devices, while USB charging supports recharging the built-in battery. Micro SD card support offers another playback option without relying solely on Bluetooth. The compact, lightweight design and black finish suit users who want a small speaker that is easy to carry for casual listening at home or outdoors.

specs.playback_time: Up to 6 hours depending on usage

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
